When ''Bootcamp'' (initiative owned by ''Doomie'' and company helping newcomers to start their ''QuakeWorld'' adventure by playing practice 4on4 Team Deathmatch games with coaches on voice) went inactive, in order to promote ''QW'' and attract less experienced players to TDM, ''record'' (who just returned after another quite long break) decided to form a new team consisting of Bootcampers, ''CPMA''/Duel/FFA players and rusty ''QW'' boomers. Once disbanded majority of active players joined various ''Division Ninety Nine'' teams. 007 brand was actually the reactivation of very old Polish HPB clan and tribute to them.
